Machine Learning Engineer at EcomPulse Ltd, specializing in scalable solutions for e-commerce. Over the past three years, I’ve focused on building systems that turn raw data into actionable insights, driving growth through predictive analytics and personalized experiences.  

My work centers on natural language processing, where I’ve designed models to enhance customer support chatbots, reducing resolution times by 25% while improving user satisfaction. I’ve also led the integration of MLOps practices, using MLflow andWeights & Biases to streamline model tracking and deployment. This approach cut production latency by 40% and improved model reliability across key recommendation engines.  

Currently, I’m optimizing recommendation systems to boost conversion rates, leveraging collaborative filtering and deep learning techniques. The result? A 15% increase in average order value for our top products.  

Technical tools include Python, SQL, and cloud platforms, with a focus on data warehousing for efficient pipeline design. I thrive in environments where curiosity meets impact, and I’m always looking to refine models that solve real business challenges.  

Driven by results, not buzzwords. Let’s build smarter systems together.
